title: Fetch the one tracked branch before creating a chat-run worktree (no refspec changes)
body:
P3.2: before creating a chat-run worktree from a tracked branch, fetch that one branch with a short timeout and cached fallback, never adding a refspec (Paseo #5788 / diagnose-5556 lesson).

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec).
